about.en: MAI, originally launched as miMATIC, is QiDao's overcollateralized dollar stablecoin. It is borrowed against deposited crypto collateral across many chains and redeemable through the protocol's vaults, which is what anchors it to a dollar. The polygon deployment still carries the old miMATIC symbol on-chain. This Avalanche deployment is a legacy market that QiDao has wound down. It is minted independently of the other chains with no bridge between them, and trades far below a dollar.
about.es: MAI, lanzada originalmente como miMATIC, es la stablecoin en dólares sobrecolateralizada de QiDao. Se toma en préstamo contra colateral cripto depositado en muchas cadenas y es canjeable a través de las bóvedas del protocolo, que es lo que la ancla al dólar. El despliegue en polygon todavía lleva el símbolo antiguo miMATIC on-chain. This Avalanche deployment is a legacy market that QiDao has wound down. It is minted independently of the other chains with no bridge between them, and trades far below a dollar.

El desplegament a polygon encara duu el símbol antic miMATIC on-chain. This Avalanche deployment is a legacy market that QiDao has wound down. It is minted independently of the other chains with no bridge between them, and trades far below a dollar.
